subject: Shoreline Health — access controls onboarding: service accounts, SAML/SCIM, IP gates

Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Shoreline Health — access controls onboarding: service accounts, SAML/SCIM, IP gates

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the kickoff earlier. Attaching the initial implementation runbook and a short checklist so we can align on sequencing. High-level asks for the first delivery sprint:

- SAML: IdP metadata (federation cert + ACS URL) and preferred binding (HTTP-POST or Redirect).
- SCIM: sample export (CSV) showing your canonical username/email fields and group mappings.
- IP allowlist: CIDR ranges you can open for the cutover window and any maintenance blackout windows.
- Service accounts: whether you prefer a single long-lived service principal or ephemeral per-job keys (we recommend ephemeral for reduced blast radius).

I've copied Irene to confirm the recommended patterns from infra side and Ben for the commercial timeline. Please respond with the IdP metadata and a small SCIM export by EOD Tuesday so we can create a test tenant and run a smoke: create/update/delete cycle.

Attachments: redwood-implementation-runbook-v1.pdf

Thanks,
Jordan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@shorelinehealth.com>

Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@shorelinehealth.com>, Shoreline Security <sec@shorelinehealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Shoreline Health — access controls onboarding: service accounts, SAML/SCIM, IP gates

Jordan —

Got it, thanks. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

1) We run Okta as IdP; we'll export the metadata but need to confirm whether Redwood needs the SHA1 or SHA256 cert thumbprint (both available).
2) For SCIM, our HRMS provides a CSV export, I can attach a 100-row sample.
3) Service accounts: our security team prefers long-lived service principals for scheduled batch jobs and short-lived tokens for interactive flows. Can Redwood support mixed patterns?
4) IP allowlist — we can open a list of 8 /29 subnets during the cutover window; need to confirm firewall change window (we typically do changes 0200–0400 local).

Sending the sample SCIM export shortly. Also looping in Raj (infrastructure) and our security mailbox.

Cheers,
Alice
Director of IT Operations, Shoreline Health

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@shorelinehealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Shoreline Health — access controls onboarding: service accounts, SAML/SCIM, IP gates

Alice / Jordan —

We can definitely support mixed service-account patterns. A few implementation notes from infra:

- Service accounts:
  * Long-lived: we provision a tenant-scoped service principal with restricted scopes for scheduled batch jobs. Rotation window: recommend rotating credentials every 90 days (we can automate via our credential factory).
  * Ephemeral: we issue short-lived tokens (1 hour) backed by a signed assertion; recommended for interactive admin flows.

- SCIM mapping: please confirm which CSV column maps to the SCIM "userName" attribute. Common mappings we've seen: email, employeeId, or username. If you include a header row we can create the mapping file (example: {userName: email, externalId: employeeId, active: active}) — we'll send a JSON mapping template once we get the sample.

- SAML cert thumbprint: Redwood prefers SHA256; we can accept SHA1 too but SHA256 is recommended for the metadata import.

- IP allowlist: we support CIDR ranges; to reduce risk we can also use mutual TLS for backend traffic if Shoreline prefers not to open many CIDRs. If opening the /29 subnets during 0200–0400 is the plan, we can schedule the cutover in that window.

Next steps: Jordan/Monica, can we schedule a 45-minute tech preflight Wednesday 10:00 PT to validate the SCIM mapping and the IdP metadata import? After that we'll create a test tenant and run the smoke tests.

Thanks,
Irene
Staff Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
